sloka: त्रेताग्नयो अपि दीप्यन्ते धूमो हि एष प्रदृश्यते ।वेष्टयन् इव वृक्ष अग्रान् कपोत अंग अरुणो घनः ॥४-१३-२३॥
transliteration: tretāgnayo api dīpyante dhūmo hi eṣa pradṛśyate ।veṣṭayan iva vṛkṣa agrān kapota aṁga aruṇo ghanaḥ ॥4-13-23॥

translations.english: 'The three sacred fires keep burning and the thick smoke they emit resembles the red feet of pigeons. It shines forth as if enveloping the treetops.
